value.title: PRD 009 s04: pointers in type refusals and the first turn

sections.name: body
sections.value:
PRD 009 s04, #351 (plan 257), 2026-11-25. Type refusals (types.rs check_role_for and get) end their MESSAGE with `Read: pij docs get types[/<type>]`; never touch `next` (one runnable step) or codes. The first turn's type part (first_turn.rs assemble) is now: line, `Carries authority`, `Your type in full: pij docs get types/<type>`, only the role's own type_changes, then the seed (pm-001 ruled for req-06 as written; 36% shorter across the ten types). Page ids live in pij_daemon::community::types::{DOCS_PAGE, docs_page()}; crates/cli/src/docs.rs uses them, so refusals and pages can't drift.

Gotchas: `cargo test` takes ONE positional filter; give several after `--`. The role-start integration tests live in the `directory_http` test target (module reshape::role_start), not a `reshape_http` target. When a dependency PRD merges, re-read every page for "planned" claims it just made stale (PRD 007 made three). Still owed: the pods page (req-05) once PRD 008's pod commands are on main.
